verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an Export API for pulling raw project event data. It also documents a Dashboard REST API that returns chart and analysis results as JSON, plus cohort export endpoints, and a published OpenAPI spec was found by probe. Together these cover both halves of the story: running queries and exporting raw events. Missing for 10: detail on ad-hoc query flexibility (the evidence covers chart/dashboard-based queries, not arbitrary SQL), specifics on export format, limits or latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of these APIs.
